rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, itnet_alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.0001, pretrain_epochs=12, pretrain_patience=12, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=900, seed=42, rationale=ITER-1 feasibility (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). itnet_v2 onboarding. CONFIG: residual_learning=False (MANDATORY: the CONFIG default True double-applies the residual -- SmallUNet.forward already returns x-body(x), then ItNetV2.forward re-adds denoiser(x) -> ~2x at eval which the k DC steps cannot recover, stuck ~0.34; False matches the working v1/v3 recipe). Shared ItNet architecture seeded from itnet_v3 iter-1 (0.896 SSIM / hr0.268 under the SAME corrected metric): itnet_k=3 DC steps, unet_c=16 SmallUNet denoiser, itnet_alpha_init=0.0037 (TV-lambda, learnable), grad_clip=1.0 (mandatory: 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside dc_step overflows otherwise), seed=42. TRAINING uses v2 pretrain knobs (v2 pre-trains the denoiser then applies k=3 DC at eval; it is NOT end-to-end like v3): pretrain_lr=1e-4 (v3 unstable above; mirror), pretrain_epochs=12, pretrain_patience=12 (disable the 1pct early-stop so the full budget converges -- AVOID the v1 0.441 under-training trap). batch_size=1 + val_chunk=1 are FORCED by per-sample-ps (each slice swaps itnet.projector to its own ps). train_n=200 -> 200 steps/epoch. val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices -- do NOT reduce). max_train_s=900 (15 min) HARD backstop so train leaves room for the 214-slice per-sample val + figure inside the 30-min wall. HYPOTHESIS: itnet_v2 with residual_learning=False at k=3/c=16/lr=1e-4 for 12 pretrain epochs on 200 stratified Mayo train slices produces a finite val_ssim that CLEARS the LD-FBP baseline (hr>0) and lands in the ~0.88-0.90 SSIM band like its siblings, because a pretrained denoiser + k=3 DC-step refinement of the per-sample-ps FBP is a strong Mayo recon family and the residual_learning=False fix removes the double-residual collapse. This onboarding iter establishes the corrected-metric baseline that iter-2+ will improve by tuning ONE knob (pretrain_epochs first).

itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, itnet_alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.0001, pretrain_epochs=48, pretrain_patience=48, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=960, seed=42, rationale=ITER-2 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: pretrain_epochs 12->48 (4x); pretrain_patience tracked 12->48 so the early-stop never fires before the full 48 epochs (same disable-early-stop intent as iter-1, where patience==epochs). All else identical to iter-1 (k=3, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=1e-4, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42); only max_train_s 900->960 to admit the longer pretrain inside the wall. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) iter-1 = SSIM 0.4554 / hr 0.000 (val_psnr 21.24, val_rmse 0.00434) in elapsed_s=170.2 -- only ~14% of the 1200s (20-min) train+score budget used; pretrain_epochs=12. (2) FAILURE MODE: the pretrain-denoiser-then-data-consistency path UNDER-CONVERGES in the budget (same as v1, which was stuck at 0.441). The k=3 DC steps refine a denoiser that has not yet learned the Mayo image statistics; SSIM 0.455 is far below the end-to-end itnet_v3 sibling (0.896). With only 12 pretrain epochs at lr=1e-4 the denoiser is under-trained, and 170s/1200s proves the budget was almost entirely idle. (3) ONE KNOB: pretrain_epochs 12->48, mirroring the SIBLING itnet (v1) iter-2 which raised pretrain_epochs 8->48 and jumped SSIM 0.441->0.593 (+0.15) under THIS campaign and metric -- the strongest just-proven signal that pretraining was the v1/v2 bottleneck. Chosen over lr-up (v3 is unstable above 1e-4; mirror the safe v1 move) and over architecture knobs (k/unet_c) which would change the model not the convergence. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if pretrain_epochs 12->48, val_ssim rises substantially above 0.4554 (toward v1 iter-2's ~0.59, possibly the ~0.88-0.90 sibling band) because more pretraining lets the denoiser converge before the k=3 DC refinement, exactly as it did for v1. FALSIFIER: if val_ssim stays flat (<=~0.47) at 48 epochs, the pretrain-DC architecture is CAPPED in this budget regardless of pretraining (not an under-training problem), and iter-3 must move toward end-to-end unrolled training (the v3 recipe) or accept the pretrain-DC path is budget-limited. (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min train+score. iter-1 ran 12 epochs + 214-slice per-sample val + figure in 170s; the per-epoch pretrain cost over 200 stratified slices is the variable part and the 214-slice per-sample val + figure are roughly fixed. 4x the epochs is roughly 4x the small pretrain base plus the single fixed val/figure pass: est well under 600s, far below 1200s; max_train_s=960 is a 16-min HARD backstop so train always leaves room for the 214-slice per-sample val + figure inside the 30-min sbatch wall. val_n=214 KEPT (NOT reduced), grad_clip=1.0 KEPT. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged from iter-1): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (each slice swaps itnet.projector to its own ps; batch_size=1 + val_chunk=1 FORCED), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override). residual_learning=False KEPT (the CONFIG default True double-applies the residual and collapses eval to ~0.34).

column13: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, itnet_alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.0001, pretrain_epochs=144, pretrain_patience=144, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1100, seed=42, rationale=ITER-3 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: pretrain_epochs 48->144 (3x); pretrain_patience tracked 48->144 so early-stop never fires before the full run (same disable-early-stop intent as iter-1/iter-2 where patience==epochs). All else identical to iter-2 (k=3, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=1e-4, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42); only max_train_s 960->1100 (18.3-min HARD backstop) to admit the longer pretrain inside the 20-min train+score budget while leaving the figure outside. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) iter-1 = SSIM 0.4554 / hr 0.000 @pretrain_epochs=12 in elapsed_s=170.2; iter-2 = SSIM 0.5888 / hr 0.000 @pretrain_epochs=48 in elapsed_s=345.2. Trajectory: 4x epochs (12->48) lifted SSIM +0.133, still hr=0 (FBP floor ~0.81, far above). v3 SIBLING (same ItNet family, END-TO-END unrolled, no pretrain-DC) reaches SSIM 0.91 -- the contrast that frames v2's limiter. Budget: iter-2 used only 345s of the 1200s (20-min) budget (~29%) -- large headroom remains; the variable (pretrain) part was ~233s, fixed (214-slice per-sample val + figure) ~112s. (2) LIMITER: pretrain-DC UNDER-CONVERGENCE -- and structurally deeper: reading solver_itnet_v2.py, the DC stage is NOT trained at all. pretrain_denoiser trains ONLY the SmallUNet on (fbp, truth) residual pairs; ItNetV2 is then built and itnet.eval() runs with NO fine-tune of the unrolled net -- log_alpha (the DC step size) is never optimized, so the k=3 DC refinement is a FIXED, untrained operator wrapped around a pretrained denoiser. That is why v2 caps far below the end-to-end v3 (0.91): more pretraining only sharpens the denoiser, it cannot fix the un-trained DC coupling. (3) ONE KNOB: pretrain_epochs 48->144 (3x) -- the most diagnostic single knob to MAP the pretrain-epochs response curve and definitively decide whether the cap is epochs or architecture. Chosen over a DC-stage knob (itnet_k / itnet_alpha_init) because the DC stage carries no trainable weight (changing k/alpha shifts a fixed operator, not a learnable one -- low diagnostic value), and over lr-up (v3 unstable above 1e-4; mirror the safe sibling move). With a fixed-DC architecture, pretrain_epochs is the ONLY lever that can lift the denoiser, so pushing it 3x is the cleanest test of the ceiling. (4) HYPOTHESIS + FALSIFIER: if pretrain_epochs 48->144 lands val_ssim still ~0.59-0.65 (NOT the ~0.91 v3 band), then itnet_v2's pretrain-then-FIXED-DC scheme is STRUCTURALLY CAPPED on Mayo regardless of epochs -- the un-trained DC operator, not under-training, is the limiter -- and the campaign should treat v2 as a documented budget/architecture ceiling and use v3 instead. CONVERSELY if SSIM jumps substantially toward the sibling band, the cap was pretrain-epochs and iter-4 keeps climbing. The diminishing 12->48 (+0.133) vs the still-large gap to 0.81/0.91 predicts the former (structural cap). (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min train+score. Per-epoch ~4.86s over 200 stratified slices (from iter-1->iter-2 slope) -> 144 ep ~700s pretrain + ~112s fixed val+figure ~812s, comfortably under 1200s and the 30-min sbatch wall; max_train_s=1100 is the HARD backstop so train always leaves room for the 214-slice per-sample val + figure inside the wall. val_n=214 KEPT (NOT reduced), grad_clip=1.0 KEPT. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (each slice swaps itnet.projector to its own ps; batch_size=1 + val_chunk=1 FORCED), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override). residual_learning=False KEPT (the CONFIG default True double-applies the residual and collapses eval to ~0.34).
